title: Function-level change classification in diff_impact
description:
diff_impact reports which symbols are affected by a change but not *how* they changed. Add per-symbol change classification: added, deleted, signature_changed, body_changed.

Approach: compare symbol table (name, kind, signature_hash) between current index and prior ref parsed on-the-fly via `git show`. Sutra already stores signature_hash per symbol — diffing two snapshots classifies each symbol. The HRR semantic diff (shape changes) is a complementary signal, not a replacement — this is structured metadata, that is anomaly detection.

Also thread callee graph into diff_impact: when a symbol's body changed, diff its callee set (added/removed calls). `sutra_calls` already has the data, it's just not wired into the diff path. Small effort, high review value — "process_order now calls charge_card instead of authorize_payment" is the most useful signal for reviewing implementation changes.

Replaces old tasks: sutra/needs-designing/11, sutra/needs-designing/12.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review: needs-attention. Three findings:
1. [high] qualified_name HashMap collapses struct Foo / impl Foo — same qualified_name, different kind. Fix: compound key (name, kind).
2. [medium] callee diff uses raw ExtractedRef.name — by design, since old version has no resolved refs. Acknowledged.
3. [medium] unwrap_or_default silently swallows parse/git errors. Fix: surface per-file error indicator.
